title: Clinical Trials Central Laboratory and Bioanalysis Manager

cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Clinical Trials Central Laboratory and Bioanalysis Manager to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
· Directly supervise, support, train and mentor staff. Maintain daily central lab performance by managing resources, prioritizing tasks, and developing and monitoring metrics.
· Work with QA to create onboarding plan and continuous training and mentorship.
· Ensure Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) are reviewed, maintained, and followed.
· Working with QA to facilitate quality issue resolution, including change control and deviation management.
· Perform duties with general effective working knowledge of GCP and GCLP and other pertinent regulations, as it pertains to central laboratory functions.
· Suggest, validate, and implement service improvements to ensure efficiency and continued growth of the organization.
· Review, interpret, and monitor compliance with pertinent regulations/standards.
· Supervise and validate accuracy of samples records in inventory platform and shipping manifests.
· Oversee development and execution of GCLP bioanalysis of pharmacokinetic (PK) and anti-drug-antibodies (ADA) done by a CRO.
· Oversee timely supply of critical reagents for continuous testing of bioanalysis assays by CRO. Initiate bridging studies as needed.
· Oversee record reconciliation when needed.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
· Bachelor's Degree in Biology, Life Sciences or other related discipline
· 6+ Years of relevant experience in clinical specimen management, life science laboratory or similar setting
· 2+ Years of supervisory or team lead experience
· Experience working with human samples including PBMCs
· Good attention to detail, excellent documentation skills and willingness to work well in a group environment
· Ability to work independently
· Proficient using Microsoft Office, specifically Excel
· Ability to lift and carry between 1-15 lbs.; Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. Overhead with assistance; frequently required to sit, grasp, and use right/left finger dexterity; May be exposed to a cold freezer environment (Freezer temperatures range between -20ºC -196ºC)
· Must be able to read, write, speak fluently and comprehend the English language
· Clinical Laboratory Management / Technologist certificate
Preferred Requirements
· M.Sc. / Ph.D.
· Ability to interact and function in a highly productive work environment
· Knowledge in clinical pharmacology

[Company name masked] is a late-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery and development of novel biologicals for cancer treatment. The leading clinical candidate is [Product name masked], a next generation anti-CTLA-4 antibody. [Product name masked] is currently evaluated in Phase 2 and Phase 3 studies as a single agent and in combination in advanced solid tumors.
This position is part of the translational research group at [Company name masked]. It includes both overseeing [Company name masked] in-house clinical trial central lab as well as overseeing bioanalysis of PK and ADA for clinical samples by CRO. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of clinical lab operations and bioanalysis workflows.
cond_0103.responsibilities:
· Directly supervise, support, train and mentor staff. Maintain daily central lab performance by managing resources, prioritizing tasks, and developing and monitoring metrics.
· Work with QA to create onboarding plan and continuous training and mentorship.
· Ensure Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) are reviewed, maintained, and followed.
· Working with QA to facilitate quality issue resolution, including change control and deviation management.
· Perform duties with general effective working knowledge of GCP and GCLP and other pertinent regulations, as it pertains to central laboratory functions.
· Suggest, validate, and implement service improvements to ensure efficiency and continued growth of the organization.
· Review, interpret, and monitor compliance with pertinent regulations/standards.
· Supervise and validate accuracy of samples records in inventory platform and shipping manifests.
· Oversee development and execution of GCLP bioanalysis of pharmacokinetic (PK) and anti-drug-antibodies (ADA) done by a CRO.
· Oversee timely supply of critical reagents for continuous testing of bioanalysis assays by CRO. Initiate bridging studies as needed.
· Oversee record reconciliation when needed.
cond_0103.requirements:
· Bachelor's Degree (Biology, Life Sciences or other related discipline). M.Sc. / Ph.D. Preferred
· 6+ Years of relevant experience in clinical specimen management, life science laboratory or similar setting
· 2+ Years of supervisory or team lead experience
· Experience working with human samples including PBMCs.
· Requires good attention to detail, excellent documentation skills and willingness to work well in a group environment
· Ability to interact and function in a highly productive work environment
· Ability to work independently
· Must be proficient using Microsoft Office, specifically with Excel
· Ability to lift and carry between 1-15 lbs.; Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. Overhead with assistance; frequently required to sit, grasp, and use right/left finger dexterity; May be exposed to a cold freezer environment (Freezer temperatures range between -20ºC -196ºC)
· Must be able to read, write, speak fluently and comprehend the English language
· Clinical Laboratory Management / Technologist certificate
· Knowledge in clinical pharmacology

· Directly supervise, support, train and mentor staff. Maintain daily central lab performance by managing resources, prioritizing tasks, and developing and monitoring metrics.
· Work with QA to create onboarding plan and continuous training and mentorship.
· Ensure Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) are reviewed, maintained, and followed.
· Working with QA to facilitate quality issue resolution, including change control and deviation management.
· Perform duties with general effective working knowledge of GCP and GCLP and other pertinent regulations, as it pertains to central laboratory functions.
· Suggest, validate, and implement service improvements to ensure efficiency and continued growth of the organization.
· Review, interpret, and monitor compliance with pertinent regulations/standards.
· Supervise and validate accuracy of samples records in inventory platform and shipping manifests.
· Oversee development and execution of GCLP bioanalysis of pharmacokinetic (PK) and anti-drug-antibodies (ADA) done by a CRO.
· Oversee timely supply of critical reagents for continuous testing of bioanalysis assays by CRO. Initiate bridging studies as needed.
· Oversee record reconciliation when needed.
cond_0399.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
· Bachelor's degree in Biology, Life Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
· Around 6 years of experience in clinical specimen management, a life science laboratory, or a similar setting — or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
· Around 2 years of supervisory or team lead experience.
· Experience working with human samples including PBMCs.
· Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
· Clinical Laboratory Management / Technologist certificate, or willingness to obtain.
· Ability to read, write, speak fluently, and comprehend the English language.
· Physical ability to lift and carry between 1–15 lbs.; lift up to 50 lbs. Overhead with assistance; frequently required to sit, grasp, and use right/left finger dexterity; may be exposed to a cold freezer environment (temperatures ranging between -20ºC and -196ºC).
Preferred Requirements
· M.Sc. / Ph.D. In a relevant discipline.
· Attention to detail and solid documentation habits, with a willingness to work collaboratively in a group environment.
· Ability to interact and function in a productive work environment.
· Ability to work independently and manage tasks with reasonable autonomy.
· Background in clinical pharmacology.
cond_0399.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0399.values: We value excellence, achievement, and delivering outcomes we can stand behind. We aim to bring high standards and a results-focused mindset to our work.

The role involves working closely with colleagues to oversee the in-house clinical trial central lab and coordinating with a CRO on bioanalysis of PK and ADA for clinical samples.
cond_0423.responsibilities:
· Work alongside staff to supervise, support, train, and mentor them. Help maintain daily central lab performance by coordinating resources, prioritizing tasks, and developing and monitoring metrics.
· Coordinate with QA to create an onboarding plan and support continuous training and mentorship.
· Help ensure Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) are reviewed, maintained, and followed.
· Work with QA to facilitate quality issue resolution, including change control and deviation management.
· Carry out duties with working knowledge of GCP and GCLP and other pertinent regulations as they pertain to central laboratory functions.
· Collaborate to suggest, validate, and implement service improvements to support efficiency and continued growth of the organization.
· Review, interpret, and help monitor compliance with pertinent regulations and standards.
· Work with the team to supervise and validate accuracy of sample records in the inventory platform and shipping manifests.
· Coordinate with a CRO to oversee development and execution of GCLP bioanalysis of pharmacokinetic (PK) and anti-drug-antibodies (ADA).
· Work with the CRO to ensure timely supply of critical reagents for continuous testing of bioanalysis assays. Coordinate bridging studies as needed.
· Support record reconciliation when needed.
cond_0423.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
· Bachelor's Degree in Biology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline
· 6+ Years of relevant experience in clinical specimen management, life science laboratory, or similar setting
· 2+ Years of supervisory or team lead experience
· Experience working with human samples including PBMCs
· Good attention to detail, excellent documentation skills, and willingness to work well in a group environment
· Proficient in Microsoft Office, specifically Excel
· Clinical Laboratory Management / Technologist certificate
· Ability to lift and carry between 1–15 lbs.; ability to lift up to 50 lbs. Overhead with assistance; frequently required to sit, grasp, and use right/left finger dexterity; may be exposed to a cold freezer environment (freezer temperatures range between -20ºC and -196ºC)
· Must be able to read, write, speak fluently, and comprehend the English language
Preferred Requirements
· M.Sc. / Ph.D.
· Ability to interact and function in a highly productive work environment
· Ability to work independently
· Knowledge in clinical pharmacology

· Directly supervise, support, train and mentor staff. Maintain daily central lab performance by managing resources, prioritizing tasks, and developing and monitoring metrics.
· Work with QA to create onboarding plan and continuous training and mentorship.
· Ensure Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) are reviewed, maintained, and followed.
· Working with QA to facilitate quality issue resolution, including change control and deviation management.
· Perform duties with general effective working knowledge of GCP and GCLP and other pertinent regulations, as it pertains to central laboratory functions.
· Suggest, validate, and implement service improvements to ensure efficiency and continued growth of the organization.
· Review, interpret, and monitor compliance with pertinent regulations/standards.
· Supervise and validate accuracy of samples records in inventory platform and shipping manifests.
· Oversee development and execution of GCLP bioanalysis of pharmacokinetic (PK) and anti-drug-antibodies (ADA) done by a CRO.
· Oversee timely supply of critical reagents for continuous testing of bioanalysis assays by CRO. Initiate bridging studies as needed.
· Oversee record reconciliation when needed.
cond_0435.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
· Bachelor's degree in Biology, Life Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
· Around 6 years of experience in clinical specimen management, a life science laboratory, or a similar setting — or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
· Around 2 years of supervisory or team lead experience.
· Experience working with human samples including PBMCs.
· Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
· Clinical Laboratory Management / Technologist certificate, or willingness to obtain.
· Ability to read, write, speak fluently, and comprehend the English language.
· Physical ability to lift and carry between 1–15 lbs.; lift up to 50 lbs. Overhead with assistance; frequently required to sit, grasp, and use right/left finger dexterity; may be exposed to a cold freezer environment (temperatures ranging between -20ºC and -196ºC).
Preferred Requirements
· M.Sc. / Ph.D. In a relevant discipline.
· Attention to detail and solid documentation habits, with a willingness to work collaboratively in a group environment.
· Ability to interact and function in a productive work environment.
· Ability to work independently and manage tasks with reasonable autonomy.
· Background in clinical pharmacology.

[Company name masked] is a late-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery and development of novel biologicals for cancer treatment. The leading clinical candidate is [Product name masked], a next generation anti-CTLA-4 antibody. [Product name masked] is currently evaluated in Phase 2 and Phase 3 studies as a single agent and in combination in advanced solid tumors.
This position is part of the translational research group at [Company name masked]. It includes both overseeing [Company name masked] in-house clinical trial central lab as well as overseeing bioanalysis of PK and ADA for clinical samples by CRO. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of clinical lab operations and bioanalysis workflows.
cond_0445.responsibilities:
· Directly supervise, support, train and mentor staff. Maintain daily central lab performance by managing resources, prioritizing tasks, and developing and monitoring metrics.
· Work with QA to create onboarding plan and continuous training and mentorship.
· Ensure Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) are reviewed, maintained, and followed.
· Working with QA to facilitate quality issue resolution, including change control and deviation management.
· Perform duties with general effective working knowledge of GCP and GCLP and other pertinent regulations, as it pertains to central laboratory functions.
· Suggest, validate, and implement service improvements to ensure efficiency and continued growth of the organization.
· Review, interpret, and monitor compliance with pertinent regulations/standards.
· Supervise and validate accuracy of samples records in inventory platform and shipping manifests.
· Oversee development and execution of GCLP bioanalysis of pharmacokinetic (PK) and anti-drug-antibodies (ADA) done by a CRO.
· Oversee timely supply of critical reagents for continuous testing of bioanalysis assays by CRO. Initiate bridging studies as needed.
· Oversee record reconciliation when needed.
cond_0445.requirements:
· Bachelor's Degree (Biology, Life Sciences or other related discipline). M.Sc. / Ph.D. Preferred
· 6+ Years of relevant experience in clinical specimen management, life science laboratory or similar setting
· 2+ Years of supervisory or team lead experience
· Experience working with human samples including PBMCs.
· Requires good attention to detail, excellent documentation skills and willingness to work well in a group environment
· Ability to interact and function in a highly productive work environment
· Ability to work independently
· Must be proficient using Microsoft Office, specifically with Excel
· Ability to lift and carry between 1-15 lbs.; Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. Overhead with assistance; frequently required to sit, grasp, and use right/left finger dexterity; May be exposed to a cold freezer environment (Freezer temperatures range between -20ºC -196ºC)
· Must be able to read, write, speak fluently and comprehend the English language
· Clinical Laboratory Management / Technologist certificate
· Knowledge in clinical pharmacology

[Company name masked] is a late-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery and development of novel biologicals for cancer treatment. The leading clinical candidate is [Product name masked], a next generation anti-CTLA-4 antibody. [Product name masked] is currently evaluated in Phase 2 and Phase 3 studies as a single agent and in combination in advanced solid tumors.
The position is part of the translational research group at [Company name masked]. It includes both overseeing [Company name masked] in-house clinical trial central lab as well as overseeing bioanalysis of PK and ADA for clinical samples by CRO. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with central lab operations and bioanalysis work.
cond_0455.responsibilities:
· Directly supervise, support, train and mentor staff. Maintain daily central lab performance by managing resources, prioritizing tasks, and developing and monitoring metrics.
· Work with QA to create onboarding plan and continuous training and mentorship.
· Ensure Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) are reviewed, maintained, and followed.
· Working with QA to facilitate quality issue resolution, including change control and deviation management.
· Perform duties with general effective working knowledge of GCP and GCLP and other pertinent regulations, as it pertains to central laboratory functions.
· Suggest, validate, and implement service improvements to ensure efficiency and continued growth of the organization.
· Review, interpret, and monitor compliance with pertinent regulations/standards.
· Supervise and validate accuracy of samples records in inventory platform and shipping manifests.
· Oversee development and execution of GCLP bioanalysis of pharmacokinetic (PK) and anti-drug-antibodies (ADA) done by a CRO.
· Oversee timely supply of critical reagents for continuous testing of bioanalysis assays by CRO. Initiate bridging studies as needed.
· Oversee record reconciliation when needed.
cond_0455.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
· Bachelor's Degree in Biology, Life Sciences or other related discipline
· 6+ Years of relevant experience in clinical specimen management, life science laboratory or similar setting
· 2+ Years of supervisory or team lead experience
· Experience working with human samples including PBMCs
· Good attention to detail, excellent documentation skills and willingness to work well in a group environment
· Ability to interact and function in a highly productive work environment
· Ability to work independently
· Must be proficient using Microsoft Office, specifically with Excel
· Ability to lift and carry between 1-15 lbs.; Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. Overhead with assistance; frequently required to sit, grasp, and use right/left finger dexterity; May be exposed to a cold freezer environment (Freezer temperatures range between -20ºC -196ºC)
· Must be able to read, write, speak fluently and comprehend the English language
Preferred Requirements
· M.Sc. / Ph.D.
· Clinical Laboratory Management / Technologist certificate
· Knowledge in clinical pharmacology

The role involves working closely with colleagues to oversee the in-house clinical trial central lab and coordinating with a CRO on bioanalysis of PK and ADA for clinical samples.
cond_0531.responsibilities:
· Work alongside staff to supervise, support, train, and mentor them. Help maintain daily central lab performance by coordinating resources, prioritizing tasks, and developing and monitoring metrics.
· Coordinate with QA to create an onboarding plan and support continuous training and mentorship.
· Help ensure Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) are reviewed, maintained, and followed.
· Work with QA to facilitate quality issue resolution, including change control and deviation management.
· Carry out duties with working knowledge of GCP and GCLP and other pertinent regulations as they pertain to central laboratory functions.
· Collaborate to suggest, validate, and implement service improvements to support efficiency and continued growth of the organization.
· Review, interpret, and help monitor compliance with pertinent regulations and standards.
· Work with the team to supervise and validate accuracy of sample records in the inventory platform and shipping manifests.
· Coordinate with a CRO to oversee development and execution of GCLP bioanalysis of pharmacokinetic (PK) and anti-drug-antibodies (ADA).
· Work with the CRO to ensure timely supply of critical reagents for continuous testing of bioanalysis assays. Coordinate bridging studies as needed.
· Support record reconciliation when needed.
cond_0531.requirements:

· Bachelor's Degree in Biology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline
· 6+ Years of relevant experience in clinical specimen management, life science laboratory, or similar setting

· Experience working with human samples including PBMCs
· Good attention to detail, excellent documentation skills, and willingness to work well in a group environment
· Proficient in Microsoft Office, specifically Excel
· Clinical Laboratory Management / Technologist certificate
· Ability to lift and carry between 1–15 lbs.; ability to lift up to 50 lbs. Overhead with assistance; frequently required to sit, grasp, and use right/left finger dexterity; may be exposed to a cold freezer environment (freezer temperatures range between -20ºC and -196ºC)
· Must be able to read, write, speak fluently, and comprehend the English language

· M.Sc. / Ph.D.
· Ability to interact and function in a highly productive work environment
· Ability to work independently
· Knowledge in clinical pharmacology
